key_insight: Tilted convexity preserves arbitrarily accurate offline minimization but has an exact online coefficient of γ, unless NP = RP.
engineering_relevance: For objectives satisfying these conditions, efficient offline optimization does not imply equally strong guarantees for sequential decision-making.
method: Apply a γ-dependent distortion to affine support, subdifferential monotonicity, and increasing secant slopes.
Establish three nested function classes with convex domains and no nonglobal local minima.
Prove offline approximation guarantees, online γ-regret bounds, and matching computational hardness.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical results rather than empirical evaluation: polynomial-query offline ε-accuracy for smooth members and polynomial-time O(√T) online γ-regret on the largest class.
watch_item: Guarantees require the stated oracle and projection access; the online result assumes nonpositive losses, and hardness for coefficients above γ is conditional on NP ≠ RP.
paper_title: Tilted Convexity and an Exact Offline-Online Separation
